source_name: ČNB – Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů (JERRS), hub page
why_relevant: Master hub for every ČNB-maintained register (banks, payment institutions, e-money, small-scale providers, intermediaries). It is the canonical pointer to the full population of CZ regulated actors whose leadership/organisation changes are the A5 signal, and it links onward to JERRS, open data and WS JERRS.

source_name: JERRS – Seznam regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů (search application)
why_relevant: The live licensing register itself: per-entity authorisation wording, scope of activity, grant date, and current status (valid / suspended / revoked). New entries mark new market entrants; status changes mark exits — both are direct A5 organisation-change signals with legal reliability.

source_name: ČNB – Webové služby WS JERRS (machine-readable register API)
why_relevant: Documented XML web services (three services, XML request → XML response) exposing JERRS data to external consumers since 1 July 2019. This is the single highest-value automation target in the cell: it turns the legally-mandated register into a diffable feed of entities, roles and statuses.

source_name: ČNB – Otevřená data (open datasets, CSV download endpoint)
why_relevant: Seven CSV+JSON-schema datasets published under Government Regulation 425/2016 Sb., including banks and foreign bank branches, exchange offices, non-bank consumer-credit providers and credit intermediaries, with IČO and address fields. Lowest-friction structured baseline of the regulated population for entity resolution against commercial-register officer data.

source_name: ČNB – Povolovací a schvalovací řízení: banky (fit-and-proper / board approvals)
why_relevant: Describes the legally gated route by which a bank board member is approved: application requirements, decrees (e.g. vyhláška č. 355/2020 Sb.), forms and the Sekce licenčních a sankčních řízení contact. Defines exactly what artefacts exist for every CZ bank leadership change and therefore what to watch for.

source_name: ČNB – Povolovací, schvalovací řízení a zápis do registru: poskytovatelé platebních služeb a vydavatelé elektronických peněz
why_relevant: The payments-sector twin of the banking licensing page: requirements under vyhláška č. 1/2022 Sb. for PI / EMI / PISP-AISP authorisations, including management-body suitability documentation. Directly relevant to the payments half of the sector scope.

source_name: ČNB – Povolovací a schvalovací řízení (index of all sectors)
why_relevant: Index page fanning out to every sector's approval regime (banks, payment institutions, investment firms/funds, pension companies, insurers, consumer-credit providers). Efficient pointer for extending A5 coverage beyond banking/payments without guessing URLs.

source_name: ČNB – Pravomocná rozhodnutí České národní banky (final enforcement decisions)
why_relevant: Legally mandated publication of final/enforceable supervisory decisions (anonymised as to third parties). Licence withdrawals, activity bans and refusals of suitability are hard, dated evidence of forced leadership and organisational change — the negative-side A5 signal.

source_name: ČNB – Zpráva o výkonu dohledu nad finančním trhem (annual supervision report)
why_relevant: Annual PDF reporting on licensing and sanction proceedings, changes in the population of regulated entities and supervisory organisation. Gives counts and context that let the register diffs be calibrated and back-tested; also names ČNB's own supervisory units.

source_name: ČNB – Tiskové zprávy / Press releases (cs + en)
why_relevant: ČNB announces its own Bank Board appointments, division of responsibilities among board members, and internal reorganisations (e.g. creation of an independent HR department) here. This is the authoritative A5 feed for the regulator-as-employer and for supervisory org changes; the English mirror is a ready-made bilingual pair.

source_name: ČNB – Bankovní rada ČNB (Bank Board composition page)
why_relevant: Canonical current-state page for the seven-member Bank Board (governor, deputy governors, members) with terms of office. Diffing it detects regulator leadership turnover between press releases, and it anchors term-expiry forecasting.

source_name: ČNB – Výběrová řízení / volná pracovní místa (regulator job board)
why_relevant: ČNB's own vacancy application. Openings in supervision, payments oversight, IT and regional offices (Brno, Hradec Králové, Ostrava, České Budějovice, Plzeň, Ústí nad Labem) are a leading indicator of where the supervisor is building capacity — a pure A5 jobs/hiring signal from the regulator itself.

source_name: Veřejné rejstříky / Obchodní rejstřík (Ministry of Justice) – statutory body entries and Sbírka listin
why_relevant: The legally authoritative record of who actually sits on the představenstvo and dozorčí rada of each licensed bank / payment institution, with function start and end dates, plus the Sbírka listin (deeds collection) holding minutes and annual reports. ČNB approval is upstream; the register entry is the dated, machine-checkable confirmation of the leadership change.

source_name: ARES – Administrativní registr ekonomických subjektů (MF ČR) with REST/open data
why_relevant: Ministry of Finance aggregator over the commercial register, trade register and VAT register, with a documented API and IČO-keyed records. Best programmatic bridge between ČNB register identifiers and officer/company data — the practical join key for the whole cell.

source_name: EBA – Central register of payment and electronic money institutions (PSD2)
why_relevant: EU-level mirror of the ČNB payments register, fed by the national competent authority and updated at least daily, with full-content download. Gives a second, independently timestamped view of CZ PI/EMI entries and passporting — useful for cross-validating ČNB register diffs and catching inbound entrants.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities + fit-and-proper explainer (cs available)
why_relevant: CZ is not in the euro area / SSM, so ECB does not approve CZ bank boards — but ECB material sets the fit-and-proper vocabulary ČNB mirrors, and the periodic list-of-supervised-entities PDFs matter for CZ subsidiaries of SSM parent groups, where group-level leadership decisions drive local changes.

source_name: Finanční analytický úřad (FAÚ) – AML supervisor, annual reports and obliged-entity guidance
why_relevant: Second statutory regulator touching banks and payment institutions. Its obligation for obliged entities to notify a designated contact person (kontaktní osoba) creates a compliance-role signal, and its annual reports document inspections and its own organisational changes.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – finanční trh / přímo řízené organizace
why_relevant: MF ČR is the legislative owner of financial-market law and the parent of FAÚ; its pages document the institutional map and senior appointments in state financial bodies. Useful as a pointer to statutory bodies adjacent to ČNB rather than as a direct leadership feed.

source_name: ČNB – Ostatní seznamy (other lists: notifications, cross-border providers, misc registers)
why_relevant: Catch-all page for registers not covered by JERRS or open data — including notified cross-border providers and specialised lists. Snowballing it expands the actor map for A5 beyond domestically licensed entities.

source_name: Nejvyšší správní soud – Sbírka rozhodnutí (judicial review of ČNB suitability decisions)
why_relevant: Case law on standing to sue against ČNB decisions surfaces contested fit-and-proper and licensing outcomes that ČNB itself anonymises or does not publish. Low volume but very high specificity for disputed leadership approvals.

source_name: Komerční banka — Tiskové zprávy (press releases)
why_relevant: KB publishes board appointments, resignations and division-director changes first, in Czech, with names, titles and effective dates (e.g. 'Novou členkou představenstva Komerční banky se stane Jitka Haubová'). Archive is organised by year, so back-filling and change-detection are both straightforward.

source_name: Komerční banka — Povinně uveřejňované informace / Pro investory (regulatory disclosures on board changes)
why_relevant: As a listed issuer KB must disclose board elections and departures separately from marketing PR. These 'Oznámení o změně členů představenstva' notices carry exact effective dates and predecessor/successor pairs — the cleanest structured leadership-change record for CZ banking.

source_name: Česká spořitelna — Tiskové zprávy (press releases, date-pathed archive)
why_relevant: Largest CZ retail bank (Erste group). Its press archive uses a /YYYY/MM/DD/ URL pattern, making systematic date-scoped crawling easy. Announces board members, division directors and reorganisations; also flags Erste-group cross-postings that signal talent flows between Vienna/Bratislava and Prague.

source_name: Česká spořitelna — 'Naši lidé' (management/board roster page)
why_relevant: Roster of board members and their portfolios. Diffing this page over time detects role reallocations and silent departures that never get a press release — the classic 'organization change' signal without an announcement.

source_name: ČSOB — Tiskové zprávy / Servis pro média
why_relevant: KBC-owned universal bank; announces board composition changes ('Novým členem představenstva ČSOB zodpovědným za oblast retailu…'), reductions in board size, and senior expert hires such as group chief economist. Covers the whole ČSOB group (leasing, pojišťovna, stavební spořitelna), giving multi-entity org-change coverage in one feed.

source_name: ČSOB Pojišťovna — Pro média / Tiskové zprávy
why_relevant: Insurance arm of the ČSOB group publishes its own board reshuffles ('Organizační změny ve vedení ČSOB Pojišťovny — nové představenstvo'). Group-level moves often surface here first when an executive rotates between bank and insurer.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank — Servis pro média / Tiskové centrum
why_relevant: Listed bank (PSE), so board and supervisory-board terms, AGM decisions and management changes are announced in Czech in its press centre. Year-partitioned archives (tiskove-zpravy-2021, -2022, …) plus a /detail/<slug> pattern make crawling and back-fill mechanical.

source_name: Raiffeisenbank ČR — Informační servis / Pro média / Tiskové zprávy
why_relevant: Publishes board changes ('Změny v představenstvu Raiffeisenbank') and product/organisational news. URL scheme is year- and month-partitioned (tiskove-zpravy-2026/tiskove-zpravy-20264/DDMMYYYY-slug), which is an unusually clean crawl surface for time-scoped collection.

source_name: Air Bank — Pro novináře
why_relevant: PPF-group digital bank; its journalist page carries press releases plus media assets and PR contacts. Air Bank's leadership and org changes are also visible in the annual reports linked from the same domain, which name statutory bodies.

source_name: Fio banka — Tiskové zprávy / Média
source_subtype: corporate newsroom (+ in-house market news desk)
why_relevant: Domestic broker-bank with an active Czech press-release stream and a parallel EN page. Useful both for its own org news and — via its 'zpravodajstvi' desk — as a pointer to other banks' board announcements it covers as market news.
